title: Sequence length sweep - 64 frames
research_question: Baseline comparison point for the sequence length sweep. 64 frames is the current default.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

main_findings: Top-1 55.88% is the lowest of the three seed=42 runs (32f: 61.76%, 96f: 58.82%) and ~3 pp below the 58.8% reported by notebook 11 for the same architecture and split, which is consistent with seed-level test variance on 34 samples rather than a regression introduced by the refactor.
Val Top-1 66.07% matches the 32f run exactly, so the delta between the two lengths lives entirely on the test split.
Convergence at epoch 40 and early stopping at epoch 70 places this run in the middle of the three lengths in terms of total training time.
limitations: Single seed (42) makes the 64f baseline noisy; the 55.88% number should not be used as the reference point against which 32f and 96f are compared.
Test set has only 34 samples; single misclassifications move Top-1 by ~2.94 percentage points.
next_actions: Re-run with seeds 123 and 2026 to establish a stable 64f baseline and confirm the refactored pipeline reproduces the notebook-11 result on average.
Once the multi-seed mean is available, rebuild the sweep plot and update the SOTA comparison table in the report with mean +/- std.
